name: Cailean

facts.text: Level 65, 10,000 health, in the Cursed Forest. It calls four or five walking trees and eight to ten rotted trees, wraps foes in an acidic cloud, and heals itself at 30%.
Drawn from its spot it is 'too far away from it's habbitat and is immune to your damage'.

story: Cailean was the forest's gardener, the Sylvan say, a spirit of the court wood that tended its trees. When the wood went bad, Cailean went with it. It still tends its trees, but now they walk at its call, the green ones and the rotten ones together, and the mist that rises from its leaves eats skin. It cannot leave its grove: away from its own soil it is nothing at all, a shadow no blade can find. In its grove it is a gardener defending its garden, and it knows exactly which plants to call.
legend: Its trees come in two kinds and in numbers: hold or AoE them while the rest burn Cailean. Cure the acid cloud. It heals itself at thirty, so save a burst for that moment. Fight it in its grove; drawn away it is immune.

aggro: My garden does not want you.

phases.text: The sap rises. The garden mends its gardener.

lairEntry: Trees lean toward you, green and rotten both.

phases.text: Cailean's trees uproot themselves and walk!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Cailean's grove is still. Its trees sleep.

briefing: cailean calls a lot of trees. [aoe them|hold the trees], cure the acid, burst it at thirty when it heals
aftermathWin: cailean down and every tree [just stopped|froze mid-step]
aftermathLoss: it healed at thirty and we had [nothing left|no burst]
rumour: [heard|someone said] cailean was the gardener of the cursed forest before it went bad

loremasterTopic.text: The gardener of the court wood, gone bad with it. Its trees walk at its call, and it cannot be harmed away from its grove.

chronicle.win: {realm} went into the Cursed Forest under {raidLeader} and put down Cailean in {minutes} minutes.
chronicle.loss: {realm}'s band under {raidLeader} came back from the Cursed Forest without Cailean's head after {minutes} minutes.
